Path Prefix Reserved
RFC 8615 reserves the path prefix `/.well-known/`.

* **Supporting Quote (Section 1):**  
  > "To address these uses, this memo reserves a path prefix in HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket (WS), and Secure WebSocket (WSS) URIs for these \"well-known locations\", \"/.well-known/\"."

---

### 2. Registration Policy for New Well-Known URIs
The registration policy is **Specification Required**, evaluated on the advice of designated experts.

* **Supporting Quote (Section 5.1):**  
  > "Well-known URIs are registered on the advice of one or more experts, with a Specification Required (using terminology from [RFC8126])."

---

### 3. URI Schemes It Applies To
RFC 8615 updates and applies directly to the `http` and `https` schemes, and applies to any other URI scheme whose definition explicitly supports well-known URIs (including `ws`, `wss`, `coap`, `coap+tcp`, `coap+ws`, `coaps`, `coaps+tcp`, and `coaps+ws`).

* **Supporting Quote (Section 1):**  
  > "Well-known URIs can also be used with other URI schemes, but only when those schemes' definitions explicitly allow it."

* **Supporting Quote (Section 3):**  
  > "This specification updates the \"http\" [RFC7230] and \"https\" [RFC7230] schemes to support well-known URIs. Other existing schemes can use the appropriate process for updating their definitions; for example, [RFC8307] does so for the \"ws\" and \"wss\" schemes."
